_comment: Driver settings Setup writes under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\apollo\Parameters, before it
switches any unit (apollo-helper regdefaults; the format is in installer\helper\defaults_plan.h).
Change them per release here (or put a defaults.json in the frozen build's root folder, which wins).
A number becomes REG_DWORD. For hex or a string value use { "type": "dword" or "sz", "data": ... }.
overwrite false keeps a value already on the machine (an upgrade keeps your tuning); "overwrite": true on a
value or on a subkey forces it.
Only values that DIFFER from the driver's built-in defaults are listed (driver\apollo_unit.h ApolloParamDef);
everything else is left to the driver. Lookup per unit (driver\unit.c): Units\<unit key> -> Models\<TT>
-> the service-wide values below (x8p only) -> built-in default.
values: the service-wide (legacy) values, which the driver applies to the Apollo x8p only. Built-in x8p
defaults: StripsEnable 0, StripSteps 1, StripMask 0x01, StripDsp 1, MixerInitBatch 1, Endpoints 0x1FFFF.
The x8p runs its full input strips on all eight inputs: StripsEnable 1, StripSteps 9, StripMask 0xFF.
subkeys Models\99: the Apollo Twin X Gen 1 (device type 0x99). Built-in Twin X defaults: Mode 0 (observe),
StripsEnable 0, StripSteps 0, StripMask 0x03, StripDsp 1, MixerInitBatch 1, Endpoints 0x3F. It runs in Mode 2
(full: Windows endpoints, monitor, preamps, strips) with its strips on: Mode 2, StripsEnable 1. StripMask 0x3,
StripDsp 1 and MixerInitBatch 1 are its built-in defaults already, and StripSteps stays 0.
The old EnabledEndpoints value is gone: the driver ignores it since Nov 15 2026 (the value is now Endpoints,
with the defaults above), and Setup leaves Endpoints alone.
